scientific_integrity: The unrestricted result has a self-contained elementary collapse and CW attachment proof and was verified against finite simplicial computations. Novelty comparisons are bounded by discoverability of prior literature; independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Proves an ordinary noncanonical homotopy equivalence for inclusive scale two on the discrete unweighted vertices of the once-subdivided finite connected simple graph with at least one edge; it does not assert natural, equivariant, or PL equivalences or describe later scales. Finite verification is a consistency test, not a proof of the universal statement.
title: Scale-two Rips homotopy of arbitrary once-subdivided graphs
